name: comp-22
title: Input With Button
description: A labelled email field paired with a separate outlined Send button in one row. The field takes an address and the button sits at its right with a small gap.
use: A one-line email capture or single query where the follow-up action sits right beside the field.
avoid: The button has no handler and there is no validation, so it needs wiring before real use.
a11y: The label is bound to the field and the button is a real button; the only gap is the missing reduced-motion check. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a row on a black stage: a dark rounded field showing a grey Email placeholder, then a short gap, then a matching outlined Send button with pale text. Focus draws a light ring around the field.
behaves: Clicking the field shows a focus ring and a caret, and typing fills the field while the Send button keeps its place. The clip enters maya@stashui.dev and leaves it in place; the button never changes.
customise: The label, Email placeholder and Send text are written in the file; field and button styling come from their shared components and can be swapped there.
weight: light: A single field and a button; no animation or script runs.
